reuse: All original/reference/manual/refinement/extraction steps are the actual recorded producer conversions. This Pond row binds them to its native blueprint and required states; no duplicate ImageGen or new liquid simulation.
original_limit: Pond default puddle mask is not its dynamic connected liquid atlas. Retained native pool context and installed LiquidVolume are the source for pool identity and state semantics.

required_states.shallow: Native thin/wading water state selects the shallow resource without conflating those native movement categories.
required_states.deep: Native IsSwimmingDepth selects deep material. Do not turn every Pond deep merely because this authored state exists.
required_states.shore: All visible eligible wet neighbors control shoreline. Swimming neighbors separately control deep-to-shallow blending; a depth edge is not a bank.
required_states.foreground: Water underlay must not consume the native winning foreground object. Transparent foreground art is drawn afterward using its own tint/visibility, with no water tint, opaque black box or liquid silhouette clipping.
